# 校服定款比例05｜作者已采用
2026-10-11 作者原话：“可以啊，校服就这个样了，定款吧。然后呢，把整个校服的那三件套，就四视图、装造分解、穿搭分解做出来，然后就 OK，然后今天就讲完事”。
本图是当前校服唯一造型主参考：清秀面容、清晰收腰、自然腰线、略短裙摆、右侧襟小盘扣、鞋背花叶绣和单侧膝下袜。后续三件套归于知夏校服定款三件套-20261011-v2.0，已替代旧v1.1板作为下游设定参考；背面和遮挡部位仍为生成补全。

原始生成提示词
Edit this exact fictional youthful school-uniform character portrait, preserving her current refined face, face inset, hairstyle, youthful age, posture, full figure framing, current waist HEIGHT, current skirt hem length and leg length. Make TWO specific design improvements only:
1. MORE LEGIBLE STYLIZED TAILORING SILHOUETTE. The author prefers anime character-design proportions rather than a flat straight garment silhouette. Make the ivory blouse's side seams taper inward more clearly at the existing natural waist, with a smooth graceful inward curve from the ribcage to waist. Narrow the matching skirt waistband accordingly, and let the pleated skirt flare outward gently below upper hip. This creates a visibly clearer shoulder-waist-skirt rhythm through illustrated clothing tailoring. Keep the youthful body healthy and comfortably clothed: no exaggerated chest or hips, no constricted corset waist, no exposed midriff, no mature glamour pose. Do not enlarge the bust or hips. Do not raise or lower the waistline, do not shorten the skirt further. Maintain full blouse-to-skirt coverage and the clean edge-to-edge junction; never return to a flared blouse overlapping the skirt. Abdomen cloth should lie smooth, with no bulging pouch or overhanging flap.
2. ADD SMALL REFINED EMBROIDERY ON BOTH SHOE VAMPS. Preserve the current ivory round-toed flat cloth shoes, same low sole and blue edge binding and existing restrained blue flowing side-line embroidery. On the broad TOP of EACH shoe, add a small asymmetric sprig of delicate pale blue flower petals and silver-white leaves, fine silk-thread satin stitches with a tiny natural pearly highlight. Motif covers only about a quarter of each upper, with plenty of ivory blank space. Pair coordinated placement on the two shoes, designed to echo the skirt botanical sprig but with distinct simpler drawing. The delicate stem can follow a loose flowing arc related to the side embroidery. NO bulky shoe ornament, no bows, no gems, no metal badge, no repeated cloud tattoo emblem, no full allover pattern, no red or gold accents. Embroidery must be visibly present on the TOP/vamp rather than only shoe sides.
Preserve the blouse's asymmetric RIGHT-side fastening (viewer LEFT) and its TINY blue frog closures, blue neckline and cuff trim, pale blue pleated skirt and its single white botanical sprig; keep all details and their locations. Same gardenia at right low bun, shallow flat bar clip on left crown, chestnut hair, pearl-white/blue backpack and smile-screen water bottle, left bracelet, right waist capsule, right calf cloud mark, left thin ivory BELOW-KNEE sock. No added leg accessories.
Preserve the original clean soft polished 3D-anime CG visual style and portrait background. Main fullbody and existing upper-right face inset only; no new layout panels, no text or callouts. Every foot remains completely visible. Exact same face. The waist treatment should read as a clear intentional stylized clothing silhouette, and the shoes should look delicately finished rather than plain.

# 校服定款v2.0｜四视图来源与提示词
2026-10-11 定款三件套交付。唯一造型依据为作者已定款的比例05，不再混用旧脸、宽腰、长下摆或素鞋版本。
保持清秀面容、自然腰线下的清晰收腰、短衫与裙腰相接、略短裙摆、偏侧小盘扣、鞋背花叶绣。人物右侧云纹裸小腿/鞋内袜、左侧膝下袜；右低髻白栀子、左头顶浅弧发夹；水杯右侧挂书包。
本卡可用于后续图像/视频维持外观。侧背面、单品遮挡处和妆造局部是AI补全示意，不是实测裁片或精确三维建模图；底稿优先于生成的小差异。四视图独立文件是原像素裁切。输出与完整来源记录见知夏校服定款三件套-20261011-v2.0/README.md。

初始实际提示词
The supplied image is the AUTHOR-FINALIZED design of fictional Lin Zhixia. It is the SINGLE authority for identity, proportions, hair, clothes, accessories, palette and CG finish. Do not redesign or regress to an earlier version. The large fullbody and inset show the same face: delicately tapered soft oval, softly rounded chin, warm brown eyes, gentle closed-lip smile, warm chestnut hair. Maintain youthful age, healthy stylized anime-CG appearance.
EXACT GARMENT: ivory short-sleeved blouse with sky-blue collar and sleeve binding; asymmetrical diagonal collar leads to an OFF-CENTER opening on wearer's RIGHT front (viewer LEFT), THREE TINY blue frogs, narrow piping only, no broad center stripe. Tiny closures must not become large center toggles. Blouse side seams visibly taper inward into a clean fitted natural waist as approved. Short blouse ends exactly at the top of pale-blue skirt waistband, edge-to-edge, no overhanging blouse, no overlap, no bare midriff. Keep approved waist HEIGHT (not elevated toward ribs), the graceful waist silhouette, long leg proportions and skirt hem above knees exactly in proportion to source. Pleated sky-blue skirt opens below upper hip; single white botanical sprig at wearer's LEFT front lower panel, plain back. Don't widen waist or lengthen shirt into a flared peplum.
Both ivory roundtoe flat cloth shoes have skyblue edge binding, restrained flowing side-line embroidery AND a small pale-blue/silver-white flower-and-leaf silk embroidery sprig ON TOP of EACH shoe vamp. No giant cloud logos, no plain blank shoe vamps, no high heels.
Wearer's RIGHT calf has the gray-blue cloud marking and shoe hides a no-show liner; LEFT leg wears ONE fine ivory sock ending below knee with narrow scalloped cuff, plain sock field. No duplicate long sock, no garters, no above-knee sock.
Hair: paired low braided buns, small loose hair section down upper back, wispy framing fringe. ONE white gardenia at RIGHT low bun. ONE small shallow curved white/silver barrette with short pale-blue inset flat at LEFT crown, far from gardenia. No old pointed leaf clip.
Bracelet on LEFT wrist, small capsule terminal at RIGHT waist. Same pearl-white asymmetric future backpack with curved blue inset, blue straps, and white smart water bottle on RIGHT side, blue handle cap and black screen with two cyan eyes and a smile.
Anatomical sides must remain consistent: front view shows cloud bare leg, gardenia, waist terminal on viewer LEFT and tall sock/barrette/bracelet/skirt flower on viewer RIGHT; back screen sides reverse. Keep embroidery subtle, no new motifs.
Preserve delicate clean polished stylized 3D CG, matte ivory and sky-blue fabric, soft even light, no noise or gritty pattern. Unseen backs should be modest plain consistent reconstructions, never invent new decoration. Do not derive a new body type or face.
TASK: Produce ONE landscape character FOUR-VIEW sheet, EXACTLY FOUR figures and no detail insets. LEFT about40%: enlarged strictly FRONT-facing halfbody from intact crown through waist and top of skirt, face and torso straight forward, gentle established expression, shoulders level. Right60%: THREE fullbody figures of equal scale, in order strict90-degree profile nose facing SCREEN LEFT; strict180-degree BACK, head facing away; strict90-degree profile nose facing SCREEN RIGHT. Right three same crown/sole height, all feet intact, neutral relaxed upright stance with arms slightly away from body; natural long legs and tapered waist exactly as approved. All four separated by generous full-height vertical blank gutters, no overlapping hair, bags, limbs or shadow. Plain light-gray background, soft even lighting. No words, title, border, guides or watermark.
Backpack worn normally on both shoulders consistently in all views. Don't carry another bag. Screen-left-facing profile shows anatomical LEFT with long sock and bracelet, screen-right-facing profile shows anatomical RIGHT cloud calf and waist capsule; back shows long sock on viewer LEFT, cloud calf viewer RIGHT, cup on viewer RIGHT. Only show the near-side naturally visible decorations. Back blouse is short fitted plain ivory ending at skirt waistband; NOT long loose flared shirt. No blouse overlaps skirt anywhere. Back skirt plain. Keep buns low and loose back fall modest and consistent. Different side shapes are genuinely reconstructed, not mirrored. Clothing geometry must obey the approved right-side closure, defined waist, short hem, vamp flowers. Do not place center frogs to make front symmetric.

局部校验修正实际提示词
Correct ONLY specific accessory continuity mistakes in image1 (four-view sheet). Image2 is the approved reference for accessory design. Keep image1's entire faces, body proportions, defined waists, blouse side fastenings, skirt lengths, floral shoe vamps, poses, overall layout and four blank gutters.
HAIR SIDES: image1's second figure facing screen LEFT currently has a visible gardenia at its left-side bun, which is WRONG. Remove that flower from that near-side bun; put the small slim white/silver shallow barrette with blue inset on this figure's near LEFT CROWN, as the approved left-side clip. Image1's fourth figure facing screen RIGHT currently has a visible barrette near its right ear, which is WRONG. Remove that barrette; put the single white gardenia at its near RIGHT LOW BUN. Flowers belong ONLY on anatomical right low bun, barrette ONLY left crown. Keep image1 large front and back hair accessory positions as already correct. Do not add a second flower.
BACKPACK: restore image2's exact asymmetric rounded pearl-white overlapping shell, a curved blue inset biased toward one upper side, soft ivory sides and pale-blue straps. Image1 back figure currently has an incorrect symmetric center blue diamond and a long vertical center zipper: replace this backpack front outward shell with image2's asymmetric flowing overlapping panel, no central split or center zipper, no centered diamond badge. Same correction to the pack on both profiles, preserving perspective and wearing position. Maintain exactly one smart smile-faced cup on the anatomical RIGHT side, visible to viewer RIGHT in back view and near side on screen-RIGHT-facing profile; not on the left-side profile. Do not duplicate a cup on hidden side.
Don't change anything else. Clean CG finish and same full landscape dimensions.

第二次局部修正：
Edit ONLY the backpack details on this four-view reference sheet. Preserve ALL faces, hair ornaments, poses, clothing, tiny side frogs, defined waists, skirt hems, sock asymmetry, shoe embroidery and sheet layout.
The FOURTH / far-right fullbody (nose facing screen RIGHT, bare cloud calf) shows the character's anatomical RIGHT side. Its backpack is behind her torso at roughly x1220–1335,y230–412 in the1536x1024 image. The RIGHT-side smart water bottle is MISSING in this view. Add the SAME compact white bottle with blue cap/handle and tiny black smile screen with cyan eyes onto the VISIBLE near-side of this backpack, around x1260,y330; attached securely to its blue cradle, natural correct scale matching the bottle on the back-view figure. It must visibly sit ON THE BACKPACK behind the arm/torso, not on her waist and not in her hand. The small waist capsule near front of this figure remains a DIFFERENT object and stays as is. Ensure cup is visible on both the BACK VIEW and this RIGHT PROFILE, never on the LEFT PROFILE.
In the back-view backpack, remove the thin vertical center zipper-like line below the blue inset and make the lower face a smooth asymmetrical overlapping pearl-white shell like the approved design. Keep diagonally flowing shell seam and existing bottle. No new badges or pockets.
Do not alter any other pixel content unnecessarily. All heads and feet intact, same landscape canvas.

Keep bag's existing smile-faced water bottle and round blue button detail; do not change bag silhouette or compartments otherwise.
In module05, the isolated barrette is too bulky and capsule-shaped. Replace it with the exact slender single shallow-arc bar seen on image2's crown: slim ivory/silver strip with smoothly rounded ends and a SHORT pale-blue flush inset, very slight curvature, no thick oval medallion. Match worn clip. Keep its label.
Remove the handwritten marketing slogan and doodled flower in the empty far-left margin under title, leaving clean blank space. Do not touch actual item labels, title, footnote, or floral artwork belonging to clothes/shoes.

睡衣08候选｜2026-10-12
作者要求：恒温居家改短裤，研究配色重新搭配。
研究原文：https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21264737/ （Schloss & Palmer，色对和谐/偏好与明度、色相；不等于某组RGB客观最好看）。
本图判断：此前黄绿色＋大面积白裤分块明显，叶脉和橙粉图案争抢关注。新方案青瓷绿上下同色系，奶油白在领袖裤边呼应，杏桃少量点缀；中性背景评估。细节见知夏睡衣精修-20261012-v0.1/睡衣08-配色分析.md及配色测量与目标JSON。
衣着编辑底图07，校服05只提供固定右小腿云纹（短裤使其重新可见）。实际成图短裤在大腿中部，短于提示词中膝上6–8厘米目标；叶脉仍较可见，均待审。
工具：内置image_gen。图像已存项目与人物画布，不导入Eagle，不覆盖旧稿。

实际生成提示词：
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit IMAGE1 (current sleepwear07) into one coherent SHORT-PAJAMA design with a professionally controlled celadon/cream palette. IMAGE1 is the authority for face, hair, body, pose, headband, high ponytail, ivory ribbon, gathered wrist scrunchie, 3D style and general cute clothing. IMAGE2 is ONLY the reference for the PERMANENT small blue-gray cloud-shaped marking on the character's anatomical RIGHT SHIN. Do not copy image2's face, school uniform, hairstyle, accessories, inset or composition.

USER REQUEST: comfortable shorts for temperature-controlled home, and rethink the strange-looking current color combination. Keep cute lotus/water-lily/koi theme, smooth high ponytail, headband (NO HAT), wrist scrunchie, opaque modest loose fit.

CUT: Replace long white trousers with roomy cotton PAJAMA SHORTS ending about 6–8 cm ABOVE KNEECAPS, lower-thigh length, clean generous leg openings, elastic waist concealed under the untucked upper-hip-length top. Clearly shorts with a visible crotch divide, no skirt, not microshorts, not knee-length sports cargo shorts, no long trousers. Same loose short-sleeve top, rounded small collar, no fitted waist or exposed midriff. Legs below shorts are naturally bare; no knee socks. With the right shin now visible, accurately retain the permanent subdued blue-gray cloud motif from IMAGE2 on anatomical RIGHT shin, left shin bare. This is a small existing body mark, never a new accessory, never mirrored.

COLOR PLAN: Both TOP AND SHORTS share one fresh slightly BLUE-leaning pale CELADON GREEN, target approximately sRGB #A9CCC1. Remove the existing yellow/lime cast. Shorts may be a very small value step darker than top while remaining the SAME hue family, clearly one matching pajama set, not dark shorts. Use warm MILK/CREAM WHITE #F5EFE1 on the small collar, narrow sleeve cuffs, narrow short hems, satin ponytail ribbon and most of the koi. A tiny amount of deeper muted lotus green #5F8578 defines selected fine piping and motif details ONLY, not large dark bands. A restrained soft APRICOT/PEACH #DDA38E is an accent on a few koi patches and flower centers ONLY; remove bright orange and hot pink. Approximate outfit-area hierarchy: 65% celadon family, 27% cream, 5% deeper green, 3% peach. These are visual design guides, not exact image-pixel ratios. Fresh airy pastel appearance with sufficient tonal definition, neither muddy gray nor neon mint.
Repeat the same celadon and cream on headband, wrist scrunchie and slippers so accessories belong to this palette. Slippers stay closed-toe flat soft cotton cream with celadon sole edge, tiny simplified fish motif.

PATTERN AND MATERIAL: Preserve real-lotus-leaf inspiration, but the current visible bright vein diagram is too busy. Reduce leaf-vein contrast by about 75%, same-color micro-jacquard, delicate low-relief radial branching visible only upon close inspection in grazing light, soft matte cotton. NO bright white veins, giant leaf-center starbursts, dark webbing, grid, cracked surface or literal botanical leaf plates. Shorts mostly clean with only ONE tiny cream lotus-leaf stitched detail near one hem.
Chest: keep a cute smiling round koi and lily-pad motif, but REDUCE the previous motif to about two-thirds its former width. Cream-bodied koi with a few muted peach patches, small celadon/deeper-green leaf, tiny cream water-lily with a peach center. Clean flat soft appliqué illustration, no embossed giant 3D mascot. Retain generous unprinted cloth. Do not spread extra little contrasting icons down the entire outfit.

COLOR-EVALUATION LIGHTING: replace the current pink/lavender-gradient backdrop and pink glow with a plain neutral very light warm-gray studio background, near #ECECE7. Soft neutral daylight, no purple, peach or green color cast on cloth. Preserve the gentle high-quality stylized 3D game-CG rendering, face identity, smooth conditioned chestnut ponytail, gentle expression and full-length eye-level framing. One person, full head and both slippers visible, no panels, swatch chart, text or labels. The design should read as a coordinated cute home set rather than green shirt plus unrelated white pants.
